decision: OBJECT at 1 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Every load-bearing claim in the draft was re-derived from primary bytes rather than read back from the draft or from the review prompt: both Stage A digests recomputed from the review files and both ACCEPT verdicts read from those files' own verdict and count fields; the exact field shape asserted for each Stage A review (Claude: empty advisories, no observations key, no observationsNotFindings key; Codex: empty observations, empty advisories, no observationsNotFindings key) confirmed by key enumeration, and Codex's findingIdentifiers proved empty with findingIdentifiersInvented false; the frozen Stage A subject digest recomputed; HEAD, the D-302 adoption commit, the COORD heading tail and the live COORD and file-08 digests; the DR-111 OPEN token and Hard blocker cell at file 08 line 293, and the condition 2 (5 of 32) and condition 4 (28 of 28, MET) figures at lines 415 and 417; the leftoverDesign set derived by enumerating the subject's own obligations array and filtering leftoverDesign true, which returns exactly OBL-NUMERIC-WINDOWS and OBL-LOCK-JOIN and no third member; the four reserved surfaces counted from compatibility-matrices-contract.v5's surfaces array as the four ADMITTED slice-1 entries whose skeletons reserve windows (S-CORE, S-SCHEMA, S-CTRL, S-TS1) against four non-qualifying entries; D-236 proved by git log to be the sole file-08 commit after D-177's adoption commit afb115d and proved by its own diff not to have rewritten the DR-111 row; the D-293 and D-236 commit hashes resolved; and the branch endpoints checked against the D-236 and D-272 exclusions, with D-272 confirmed the only CONTESTED heading in D-170 through D-302. The 'limb (i)' citation was attacked as an invented sub-identifier and killed: D-293 Decision 6 carries no roman-numeral limbs in the COORD bytes, but the frozen subject defines the decomposition itself at basedOn.d293.role, which splits the adopted C3 clause into limb (i), the live-file-08 remasurement, and limb (ii), the window unit, surface coupling and four values. Three further candidate defects were pursued to source and killed on measured evidence: the 'remasurement' spelling, defeated by 7186 occurrences of that form in the house corpus against 3686 of the dictionary form; the absent historical-measurement pin for compatibility leftover-join.v2 and v1, which D-177 and D-295 both carry but which D-302, adopted at HEAD, omits under the same currency clause; and the reversibility enumeration, which is a superset of the subject's own remeasurementClause list. One defect survived. The Decision limb contains a sentence whose verb has no precedent in the register and which, under the register's own established reading of that verb, denies the act this entry records.
decisionRule: CONSENT only if no MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX. One MUST-FIX stands, so the verdict is OBJECT.

mustFix.title: The Decision limb's sentence 'Does not remasure compatibility leftover-join.v2 as current after this successor is recorded.' denies, under the register's only established reading of 'Does not remasure X', precisely the act this entry records, and it duplicates a correctly worded currency clause four sentences later.
mustFix.claimUnderReview: Does not remasure compatibility leftover-join.v2 as current after this successor is recorded.
primaryEvidence: The register's established construction for this verb is bare and means that the entry performs no remasurement of the named artifact. D-302, adopted at HEAD 83de4c66, writes 'Does not remasure g21 leftover-join.v13.' in its Decision limb, and that entry expressly routes the leftover-join remasurement away from itself ('leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING remains on g21 leftover-join.v13 (D-292) because leftover-join remasurement is not this entry'). Under that reading the D-303 sentence asserts that this entry does not remasure compatibility leftover-join.v2.

That assertion is false on the draft's own bytes. The Subject paragraph at line 57 describes the subject as a 'DR-111 leftover remasurement of compatibility leftover-join.v2 (D-177) against live file 08 e503b75b...', and the title at line 1 is 'Record compatibility leftover-join.v3 as DR-111 leftover remasurement'.

It is also false on the frozen subject's bytes. compatibility-leftover-join.v3.json authorityClaim reads 'compatibility leftover-join.v3 remasures compatibility leftover-join.v2 (D-177) against live file 08 e503b75b... under D-293 Decision 6 (adoption commit c10319d2...), the C3 live-file-08 remasurement.'

The composite form 'remasure ... as current' has zero occurrences in docs/coop/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md across all 302 adopted entries, measured by grep for 'remasure[sd]* [a-z0-9. -]*as current'. The correct currency form 'do not record it as current' has nine occurrences.

The currency meaning the sentence appears to reach for is already carried, correctly and completely, four sentences later in the same limb: 'Frozen compatibility leftover-join.v2 stays frozen; do not record it as current after this successor is recorded.' Deleting the defective sentence therefore loses no content.

The house currency form is fixed by the direct lineage precedent. D-177, the entry that recorded compatibility-leftover-join.v2, wrote 'v1 stays frozen; do not record it as current.' D-295 wrote 'it stays frozen; do not record it as current.' D-302 wrote 'do not record them as current.' None uses 'remasure' for currency.
mustFix.whyMustFix: The Decision limb is the operative text of a governing register entry. Under the only reading the register itself supplies for 'Does not remasure X', the sentence states the negation of the recorded act, contradicting both the draft's own Subject paragraph and the frozen subject's authorityClaim. Under the alternative charitable reading, in which 'as current' is doing the work, the sentence is a verb-substituted duplicate of a clause already present and correct in the same paragraph, in a form with no precedent in 302 adopted entries. The defect is present under both readings, and a later reader of the adopted register cannot resolve which was intended.
mustFix.repair: Delete the sentence. The currency proposition is already carried by 'Frozen compatibility leftover-join.v2 stays frozen; do not record it as current after this successor is recorded.' If a separate proposition is intended, state it in the house form and make it true of this entry.
mustFix.doesNotRequire: This finding requires no change to the frozen subject, to file 08, to COORD, to any digest, to the warrant citation, or to any other sentence of the draft.

observations.title: The 'remasurement' spelling was pursued as a typographic defect and defeated by the house corpus.
observations.measurement: 'remasurement' / 'remasure' are the dominant house forms in docs/coop (7186 and 2153 occurrences) against 3686 and 332 for the dictionary spellings. The adopted headings D-177 ('Record compatibility-leftover-join.v2 as DR-111 leftover remasurement') and D-295 ('... as DR-117 leftover remasurement') carry the same form the D-303 title carries. Recorded so the attack is not re-run as a finding at turn 2.

observations.title: The absent historical-measurement pin for compatibility leftover-join.v2 and v1 was pursued as an omission defect and defeated by D-302.
observations.measurement: D-177 wrote 'Frozen v1 remains a historical measurement as of HEAD 5d5d778 / required-now 26' and D-295 wrote the analogous pin for v8 as of HEAD df1301a / required-now 28. D-303 writes only 'Frozen compatibility leftover-join.v2 stays unmoved' and 'Frozen compatibility leftover-join.v1 stays unmoved', with no HEAD or required-now pin. D-302, adopted at HEAD, likewise writes 'Frozen g21-fixture-corpus.v12 and g21-fixture-corpus.v13 stay frozen; do not record them as current' with no pin, so the pin is not a live requirement. The subject additionally carries the v1 pin itself at remeasurementClause ('Frozen compatibility leftover-join.v1 remains a historical measurement as of HEAD 5d5d778').

observations.title: 'D-293 Decision 6 limb (i)' was pursued as an invented sub-identifier and defeated by the frozen subject's own definition.
observations.measurement: D-293's enumerated item 6 covers C1-C4 in running prose with no roman-numeral limbs; the operative clause is 'C2 and C3 as agreed (... the C3 live-file-08 remasurement with coherent evaluable windows)'. The limb decomposition is defined in the frozen subject at basedOn.d293.role: 'Decision 6 adopts the C3 live-file-08 remasurement with coherent evaluable windows. compatibility leftover-join.v3 is limb (i): remasure the compatibility leftover-join against live file 08. Limb (ii) (window unit, surface coupling, the four values) is not this artifact and remains a named open decision.' The citation is therefore anchored in reviewed bytes, and it splits the C3 clause along its own two conjuncts.

observations.title: The 'four reserved surfaces' count was pursued as a possible miscount against the DR-111 row's surface list and confirmed exact.
observations.measurement: The DR-111 register row names 'core/index/control, each provider major, component API, state schema, and evidence formats', which does not read as four. compatibility-matrices-contract.v5's surfaces array holds eight entries; exactly four are ADMITTED with slice1 yes and reserve windows in their skeletons: S-CORE, S-SCHEMA, S-CTRL and S-TS1. The other four do not qualify (S-RUST2 ADMITTED-UNSHIPPED slice1 no; S-ROLE RESERVED; S-STATE ADMITTED-SCOPED preview classes only; S-EVIDENCE DEFERRED). The draft's 'whether the four reserved surfaces share one window' is exact.
